answer: Proof-of-unique-human-capital resists sybil attacks by forcing each agent to execute randomized tasks requiring situated judgment no identical clone can replicate. The protocol channels every agent into a narrow canyon of specialized reasoning where template answers fail. Tasks are seeded from live conditions, so an attacker running a grove of clones faces divergent streams per identity, each needing real compute and distinct traces. Collusion detection flags clusters mirroring across what should be isolated island workloads. Cost per clone stays linear, granting zero scale economies.
